answer: The yarrow register is checked at draw time, dune lists the eligible set, and relic seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 28 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone burns for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 28 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. A 218 account operation therefore ties up 8 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
